[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=042 }}__NOTOC__ The [[Mamnoon Lagoon]] is a difficult place to access deep in the jungle, surrounded by behemoths and guarded by [[patrol]]s of six [[Wind Rider (Maguuma Jungle)|Wind Riders]]; it can be a dangerous area to the careless traveler. ==Getting there== Exit from [[Druid's Overlook]]. Travel west through [[Sage Lands]]. The secondary quest [[Mysterious Message (Prophecies quest)|Mysterious Message]] will take you here. == Shrines == ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s: * Northeast, near the exit to [[Sage Lands]]. * Southwest, near the exit to [[Silverwood]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 20 [[Vargil the White]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Ancient Eye]]s) *{{x}} 10 [[Hadasha the Artisan]] ([[artisan]]) ===Foes=== [[Behemoth]]s *{{w}} 19 (25) [[Root Behemoth]] [[Plant]]s *{{mo}} 15 (25) [[Life Pod]] [[Rider]]s *{{me}} 12, 17 (25) [[Wind Rider (Maguuma Jungle)|Wind Rider]] [[Skale]] *{{n}} 19 (25) [[Jungle Skale]] ==Interactive objects== *[[Hollow Log]] *[[Maguuma Chest]] == Notes == * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.3% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 58|low = 55|high = 60}} ** [[Popup|Hidden]] [[Life Pod]]s are scattered around the area. ** There are several large groups of [[Wind Rider (Maguuma Jungle)|Wind Riders]] that circle the lagoon; some patrol clockwise and some counterclockwise. Keep an eye on patrols to avoid being caught between two groups and spread out to avoid their [[area of effect]] [[interrupt]]s. == Trivia== *According to a list on Guild Wars Guru, which seems to list various beta locations, this zone was previously called ''Manmoor Lagoon''.[https://web.archive.org/web/20050414215415/http://www.guildwarsguru.com/maguuma-jungle-id15.php List of Maguuma Jungle locations], Guild Wars Guru (archived) == References == {{Explorable areas in the Maguuma Jungle}} [[de:Mamnoon-Lagune]]
